About Me

I am R.S. Rakesh, a passionate Fitness Coach, Acupuncturist and Sujok Specialist dedicated to transforming lives through fitness, nutrition, movement and holistic wellness.


My fitness journey began in 2013, and I started my professional career in 2018. With a strong commitment to continuous learning and professional development, I established my own wellness brand, PK Fitnz Healthy Fitnz, in 2020.


Over the years, I have developed expertise in weight loss, physique transformation, personal training, acupuncture and Sujok therapy.


My professional approach combines fitness coaching, nutritional guidance and complementary wellness practices to help individuals achieve sustainable health and lifestyle improvements.

My Philosophy

I believe fitness is not just about losing weight or building muscles. It is about developing strength, confidence, discipline, mobility and long-term healthy habits.


Every individual has different goals and challenges. My mission is to understand those needs and provide personalised coaching and wellness solutions.

Vision & Mission

Vision

To establish PK Fitnz Healthy Fitnz as a trusted fitness and holistic wellness brand, serving individuals, corporate organisations and communities globally.

Mission

To transform lives through fitness, nutrition, movement and holistic wellness.
